about_the_game:
The further you go, the more the universe turns against you.

Voyage Router is a navigation-driven roguelike where you chart your path across a procedurally generated overworld. It blends route-building with resource management.

Terrain, weather, HP, items; every variable matters. Reassess your path for sudden changes and aim for as many Goal Points as possible.

In a time where humanity has ventured beyond the stars...

The people living aboard the nomadic fleets, known as the Seafolk, survive by collecting Aether Pearls from the Zaia creatures who appear from the Dimensional Channels.

Board the Dimensional Submarine, the Heavy Gear, alongside your android assistant, Tico. Explore the many Dimensional Channels together.

Explore ever-changing, procedurally generated terrain

Every dive into the Dimensional Channel generates a new layout!

Use the map to read the terrain and plan efficient routes through the Goal Points where Zaia lurk.

Fight against increasingly powerful enemies

After a set number of turns, the terrain shifts and the Zaia become even more dangerous.

Reach Goal Points to upgrade your vessel and stay ahead of the threat.

Choose the right route for the right situation

The Dimensional Channels feature various points of interest to aid exploration, including Dive Points for resupplying and the Dimensional Whirlpool for fast travel.

Make sure to reroute decisively to secure better results.

Upgrade your vessel with the spoils of exploration!

Aether Pearls obtained from Zaias during dives will be cashed in upon returning to base.

Use them to upgrade the vessel and conquer the next Dimensional Channel.
